title: M1 — CV Intelligence
description: Turn an uploaded document into structured, matchable candidate data, and generate tailored materials that never fabricate anything.

title: M2 — Job Acquisition
description: Bring real postings in from lawfully accessible sources, normalised and deduplicated, with loops as the search abstraction.

title: M3 — Matching
description: Score postings against candidates explainably, and retain rejections with reasons so a thin funnel is self-diagnosable.

title: M4 — Application Orchestration
description: Prepare, authorise and submit applications, with consent recorded and duplicates structurally impossible.

title: M5 — Frontend
description: A polished interface where every visible feature is wired to real backend behaviour and no number is presented more confidently than the data supports.

title: M6 — Outreach, Analytics & Admin
description: Lawful recruiter outreach, analytics that reconcile with the event log, operational visibility, billing and GDPR obligations.

title: M7 — Infrastructure & GitOps
description: Containerise, chart, and deploy to a VPS Kubernetes cluster reconciled from Git, with observability and a tested restore path.

title: M8 — CI/CD & Hardening
description: Separate CI from CD, make the safety invariants continuously verified rather than verified once, and document the security posture.
